tables.notes: Example pizzas, sides and drinks across three categories (Pizzas, Sides, Drinks) with whole-cent prices, sortOrder set, two marked available: false so the hidden-item case is visible. Preview only — you replace them with your own menu.

The single row id 'store' for the preview: accepting orders, pickup and delivery both on, a 400-cent delivery fee, three example postcodes so delivery checkout can be tested, 25-minute pickup and 45-minute delivery estimates. Preview only — the published app starts from the built-in defaults (pickup on, delivery off until you add postcodes) and writes this row the first time you save settings.

Example orders spread across the queue: four active (received, preparing, ready), three done, one awaiting payment, one with personalDetailsClearedAt set so the cleared-details case is visible. A mix of pickup and delivery. Preview only.
Two example rows for the loop 'clear-personal-details' with deterministic ids, so the settings screen has a last-cleared date to show. Preview only.
